hobbywing_xrotor_40a_6s.source_note: HOBBYWING official: 40A continuous / 60A peak, 2-6S LiPo, no BEC. Individual ESC for multicopters (550/650 class quads). source_url normalized to the www. mirror (a.hobbywing.com fails TLS validation). Page states size "50.0x21.6x12.0mm" and weight "15g" for part_number 30901001 (International Version B, no output wires) — verbatim print order mapped to length/width/height. Version A (part 30901013, with output wires) is 42.0x21.6x12.0mm / 18.5g — NOT seeded, different part_number. Catalog hygiene (ESC XRotor variant coherence IC): mass_g corrected from a prior 26g to the page's own stated 15g for this exact PN — 26 matched neither this variant (15g) nor Version A (18.5g), was not an average or unit-conversion artifact of either, and no cited primary source was ever found for it; its origin is undocumented/unknown.

speedybee_bls_60a_30x30_4in1.source_note: Engineer purchase-ground-truth (2026-09-10), re-fetched same day. SpeedyBee official: "Continuous Current: 60A * 4" (per-channel, 4 independent outputs on one board — esc_topology=4in1, channels=4, continuous_current_a modeled as the per-channel figure same as continuous_current_a's existing single-ESC convention) / "Burst Current: 80A (10 sec)". Power input 3-6S LiPo (cells_min/max) — voltage_min/max derived per the SAME per-cell convention hobbywing_xrotor_40a_6s already uses (3.0V/cell floor, 4.2V/cell full charge): 3S->9.0V, 6S->25.2V (both rows share the 6S ceiling). Page states "Dimension: 45.6(L) * 44(W) *8mm(H)" — explicitly labeled axis order (N1), mapped directly. Weight 23.5g. BLHeli_S J-H-40 firmware and current-sensor Scale=400/Offset=0 are noted on the page but not modeled (no firmware/sensor-calibration schema fields exist). Mounting 30.5x30.5mm, 4mm holes — noted, not a schema field (no mount_pattern key exists for ESCs). Availability: page shows "Discontinued" on this re-fetch (2026-09-10) — Engineer still cites this as the real purchase identity (a part they will order/receive regardless of listed availability); seeded as cited, no replacement SKU invented.

skystars_ko50a_ii_bls.source_note: Exact Rotorama product identified as Skystars F4 V4 + KO50A II BLS (same stack page as skystars_f4_v4). Page specifies a 50A ESC, 3-6S power, current sensor, BLHeli_S firmware and 30.5x30.5mm M3 mounting with softmount — firmware/mount/current-sensor details disclosed here only (no EscSpec fields for them yet). The standalone KO50A listing specifies 41x46mm size and 13.3g mass (mapped to length_mm/width_mm/mass_g); KO50 family documented with DShot 150/300/600 (note only). Exact part number, height_mm, burst_current_a, current-sensor scale/offset, connector pinout and thermal derating for the KO50A II revision remain UNKNOWN — omitted, never invented. voltage_min/max use the same 3S→9.0V / 6S→25.2V per-cell convention as speedybee_bls_60a_30x30_4in1.
